title: Type //3,2:error
detail: Find errors with three lines before and two lines after.

title: Browse the matching events
detail: Gray lines provide context; the error stays highlighted.

title: Type x — remove last filter
detail: Undo the smart find and return to the full log.

title: Type timeout
detail: Add a focused include filter for timeout events.

title: Type cache — exclude noisy matches
detail: Stack an exclude filter without losing the timeout filter.

title: Type x — remove last filter
detail: Remove only the cache exclusion; both timeout events return.

title: Press Tab — inspect structured columns
detail: The same active filter can be viewed as a table.

title: Type x — restore the full log
detail: Remove timeout and resume browsing all events.
